name: itecs-pax8
description: Cross-platform read-only Pax8 MCP connector for ITECS finance and billing workflows.

interface.longDescription: Provides a bundled read-only Pax8 MCP server for ITECS company, subscription, product, invoice, draft invoice item, and billing evidence workflows. Credentials and runtime configuration stay outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: List Pax8 subscriptions that need billing review.
Look up Pax8 companies, products, invoices, or invoice items.
Use Pax8 read-only tools for billing evidence.
